# hpe_opsramp_servicedesk_urgency (Data Source)

Looks up an OpsRamp service desk urgency by name and returns its string ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_opsramp_servicedesk_urgency" "default_urgency" {
  name = "Urgent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The exact object name to look up.

### Optional

- `client` (String) Optional client (tenant) UUID to query against. Defaults to the provider tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The string ID of the matching object.
